messages:
iris: starting a bring-up canary for v5p0-int4 at 07:03 UTC. quant pipeline used block-wise clipping + bias-correction. rolling out 1.5% to start.

omar: ivy note: prior block-wise clipping introduced subtle token-order shifts in rerank. watch top1 and MRR per-intent.

iris: split traffic by intent and by request-length. initial slice: 1.5% global, intents: search 50%, assist 30%, qa 20%. length split: short/med/long. first 20m snapshot: global MRR_delta -0.004, qa cohort MRR_delta -0.019, p95 +35ms, token_repeats +3%.

felix: that qa hit is concentrated. propose a two-stage fallback: 1) cohort throttling (reduce cohort fraction by 50%), 2) cohort soft-route (route 25% back to baseline) if throttling insufficient. Hard rollback only if sustained 25m AND MRR_delta < -0.02 AND p95_rel > 0.30.

omar: also add an evaluation gate for "semantic fidelity" using a lightweight embedding-based concordance check. if concordance_loss > 0.04 in a cohort, escalate severity.

iris: below is a runner config proto I'll push (small-sample guards included):

```json
{
  "fraction": "0.015",
  "cohorts": ["search","assist","qa"],
  "length_buckets": ["short","med","long"],
  "min_samples_cohort": "200",
  "fallbacks": {
    "throttle_fraction": "0.5",
    "soft_route_fraction": "0.25",
    "hard_rollback": {
      "mrr_delta": "-0.02",
      "p95_rel": "0.30",
      "sustained_minutes": "25"
    }
  },
  "extra_signals": ["concordance_loss","token_repeats","avg_entropy"]
}
```

felix: +1. small nit: use cohort-weighted aggregation and require per-cohort n>=min_samples before acting.

omar: alert-bot, add `concordance_loss` to the canary watch channel and surface the top offending queries for manual triage.

alert-bot: watch registered for model v5p0-int4 (id: mdl_v5p0_int4_20260410). alerts posted to #canary-watch.

iris: running a targeted cache warmup for qa-long bucket and will bump to 4% after warmup completes.

felix: if concordance_loss triggers but other metrics are stable, prefer soft-route + targeted eval sampling rather than immediate rollback. preserves cost gains while protecting quality.

omar: agreed. add exponential smoothing to metric windows (half-life 8m) to reduce noisy flips.

iris: 30m update: warmup done, qa_long n=510, concordance_loss 0.045, qa MRR_delta -0.017, p95 +28ms. concordance examples look like paraphrase reorderings that change answer spans.

felix: since concordance_loss > 0.04 and n>500, apply soft-route (25% qa -> baseline) and schedule a 1k-sample offline eval against the same prompt set.

alert-bot: routing updated: qa cohort 25% to baseline. no hard rollback (window=25m).

omar: logging action items: 1) add concordance_loss to severity matrix, 2) implement cohort throttle action, 3) require per-cohort n guard, 4) build small triage deck for paraphrase-span failures.

iris: thanks team. if soft-route doesn't reduce concordance_loss below 0.02 in 45m we escalate to rollback.

alert-bot: canary monitor: soft-route active, no rollback triggered (last check 07:24 UTC).
